content: CSS transitions/animations are the default recommendation for UI motion — GPU-compositable, can run off the main thread, declarative, best perf-per-effort. Web Animations API (WAAPI, element.animate()) has performance identical to CSS animations (same underlying engine) but is imperative/scriptable JS with Promise-based finished/onfinish hooks, useful when animation parameters must be computed from game state at trigger time. requestAnimationFrame is for hand-rolled per-frame orchestration (e.g. canvas redraws or physics-like interpolation) — the most manual and highest-maintenance option, appropriate mainly for continuous/canvas-driven scenes, not needed for discrete state-transition animations.
